desc:
🐾 Welcome to Catch and Ride! 🏇

Catch wild animals, hop on, and ride them all the way back home! 🏠

🐾 Explore the world and hunt for animals
🤠 Catch animals and ride them back to your Pen
✨ Discover rare animals the farther you explore
⚡ Upgrade to catch bigger and better animals
🏗️ Expand your Pen to hold even more animals
💰 Earn cash while you’re OFFLINE from the animals you collect!

How many animals can you catch and bring home? 👀
